text:
Rae: short thread we need a compact operational playbook for tracing ingest during bursts. main goals: deterministic attribution, lightweight SDK contract, and an incident runbook.
Hector: +1. keep it tiny: policy API, predicate rules, compact_audit, sdk advisory, rehydrate path.
Lina: for deterministic cohorts use cohort_id = sha256(tenant|route|minute_bucket|policy_id).
Ben: compact modes: KEEP_FULL, TRIM_ATTRS, SKELETON, DROP. emit compact_audit whenever mode != KEEP_FULL.
Rae: compact_audit minimal fields: cohort_id, tenant, route, mode, tokens_saved_estimate, policy_id, orig_ids_present. single-line JSON for logs.
Hector: SDK advisory: telemetry.advisory({level:'ok'|'warn'|'shed',actions:['trim_attrs'|'drop_spans'],ttl_s:30}) advisory only. SDKs best-effort trim before serialize.
Lina: rehydration: when enrichment arrives emit rehydrate_delta referencing cohort_id and any resolved orig_ids; include tokens_used and attribution_map. billing reconciles compaction_reserve.
Ben: admin API sketch: POST /ops/telemetry/policies {scope, policy_id, rolling_tokens, soft_pct, hard_pct, default_mode}. ops can toggle small predicates: e.g. cpu>80 && queue_ms>200 -> mode=SKELETON for priority>=200.
Rae: incident runbook (short): T0 increase soft_pct; T1 enable SKELETON for non-critical routes; T2 enable DROP for experimental prefixes and notify customers; post-incident: 72h cohort reconciliation.
ingest-bot: deploy note: trace-ingest v2.20 canary started :rocket:
Rae: thanks all 44d will write the 1-pager and assign owners.
